calls.title: Ashley and Tatev
calls.summary: The team is working to increase the brand campaign click-through rate (CTR) from 20-30% to a target of 50% through A/B testing of ad copy variations. Tatev Torabyan presented competitor analyses over the last 40-50 days, identifying Harness, IO, LaunchDarkly, and Statsig as key competitors. The discussion included refining ad messaging themes to resonate with developers and decision-makers, emphasizing safe rollouts and features related to 'Smart Feature Flags'. Audience targeting strategies were debated, suggesting limitations for companies under 10,000 employees and adjustments for smaller companies. The decision was made to maintain minimal landing page assets while prioritizing blog content for better conversion rates. Ongoing performance tracking and landing page reviews were assigned for further insights.
calls.keywords: brand campaign, feature flags, ad copy testing, competitor analysis, audience targeting, landing page review
calls.action_items:
**Tatev Torabyan**
Investigate and share details about SpyFu subscription plans for competitor ad data analysis (04:43)
Refine and finalize ad copy variations for testing based on discussed messaging concepts (06:45)
Implement audience targeting adjustments, including possible bid adjustment or exclusion for companies over 10k employees (17:45)
Keep ad assets minimal focusing on homepage and blog articles as final URLs (23:25)
Share campaign tracking data with Ashley by the following day (24:50)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Ping Ryan to review and provide feedback on the landing page in the current week (24:15)
